mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CBCI_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{toUser}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CBCI_USER WHERE USER_PHONE = #{USER_PHONE}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CBCI_USER WHERE REG_DATE LIKE CONCAT('${regDate}','%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_EMAIL_SMS_AUTH_NUM ( email, phone, auth_num, input_datetime ) VALUES ( #{toUser}, #{USER_PHONE}, #{authCode}, now() )

INSERT INTO CBCI_USER ( USER_NO, USER_CODE, USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_TYPE, USER_NM, USER_PHONE, FIRM_ID, FIRM_NM, FIRM_ZIP_CODE, FIRM_ADDR, FIRM_SETUP_DATE, BUSINESS_TYPE, SECTORS, LINKED_NUM, RECOMMENDED_NUM, BILLING_YN, MONEYBANK_YN, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( ${user_no}, #{user_code}, #{USER_ID}, #{USER_PW}, #{USER_TYPE}, #{USER_NM}, #{USER_PHONE}, #{FIRM_ID}, #{FIRM_NM}, #{FIRM_ZIP_CODE}, #{FIRM_ADDR}, #{FIRM_SETUP_DATE}, #{BUSINESS_TYPE}, #{SECTORS}, #{LINKED_NUM}, #{RECOMMENDED_NUM}, 'Y', 'N', DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_CODE AS user_code, USER_ID AS user_id, USER_TYPE AS user_type, USER_NM AS user_nm, USER_PHONE AS user_phone, FIRM_ID AS firm_id, FIRM_NM AS firm_nm, FIRM_TEL AS firm_tel, FIRM_FAX AS firm_fax, FIRM_ADDR AS firm_addr, FIRM_ZIP_CODE AS firm_zip_code, DATE_FORMAT(FIRM_SETUP_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS firm_setup_date, (SELECT TYPE_NAME FROM CBCI_BIZTYPE CB WHERE CB.TYPE_NO = CUT.BUSINESS_TYPE) AS business_type, (SELECT SEC_NAME FROM CBCI_SECTOR CS WHERE CS.SEC_NO = CUT.SECTORS) AS sectors, HOME_PAGE AS home_page, TONGSIN_NO AS tongsin_no, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reg_date, IFNULL(RECOMMENDED_NUM, '') AS partner_code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA WHERE CA.USER_NO = CUT.USER_NO AND CA.DEL_YN = 'N') AS shop_count FROM CBCI_USER CUT WHERE USER_CODE = #{user_code}

SELECT (SELECT CODE_NM FROM CBCI_CODE WHERE CODE_ID = CA.SHOP_TYPE) AS SHOP_NM, CA.SHOP_TYPE, CA.SHOP_ID, CA.VENDOR_ID, CA.API_KEY, CA.API_SECRET_KEY, CA.DEL_YN FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA WHERE CA.USER_CODE = #{USER_CODE} AND CA.USER_NO = #{USER_NO} AND CA.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_USER SET USER_PHONE = #{USER_PHONE}, FIRM_ADDR = #{FIRM_ADDR}, FIRM_ZIP_CODE = #{FIRM_ZIP_CODE}, UPD_DATE = now() WHERE USER_NO = #{USER_NO} AND USER_CODE = #{USER_CODE}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_ACCOUNT ( USER_NO, USER_CODE, SHOP_TYPE, SHOP_ID, VENDOR_ID, API_KEY, API_SECRET_KEY, DEL_YN, INPUT_DATETIME ) VALUES ( #{USER_NO}, #{USER_CODE}, #{SHOP_TYPE}, #{SHOP_ID}, #{VENDOR_ID}, #{API_KEY}, #{API_SECRET_KEY}, #{DEL_YN}, now() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DEL_YN = #{DEL_YN}, UPDATE_DATETIME = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_ACCOUNT SET LOGIN_LOCK = 'Y', DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE USER_NO = ${USER_NO}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_BUSINESS_LOCATION ( USER_NO , BUSINESS_LOCATION_NUMBER , BUSINESS_LOCATION , POST_CODE , ADDRESS , TEL_NO , CHECK_INVENTORY_STORAGE , CHECK_SEND , CHECK_RETURN , CHECK_EXCHANGE , INPUT_DATE , UPD_DATE ) VALUES ( ${USER_NO} -- user_id , ${BUSINESS_LOCATION_NUMBER} -- 영업소재지수 , #{BUSINESSLOCATION} -- 사업처 , #{POSTCODE} -- 우편번호 , #{ADDRESS} -- 주소 , #{TELNO} -- 전화번호 , #{CHECKINVENTORY} -- 재고보관 , #{CHECKSEND} -- 발송 , #{CHECKRETURN} -- 반송 , 'N' -- 교환 , DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') -- input , DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') -- update )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CBCI_BUSINESS_LOCATION WHERE USER_NO = ${USER_NO} -- USER_NO ORDER BY BUSINESS_LOCATION_NUMBER -- 영업소재지수
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(BUSINESS_LOCATION_NUMBER), 0)+1 AS MAX_NO FROM CBCI_BUSINESS_LOCATION WHERE USER_NO = ${USER_NO}
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_BUSINESS_LOCATION SET CHECK_SEND = #{CHECKSEND}, -- 발송유무 CHECK_INVENTORY_STORAGE = #{CHECKINVENTORY}, -- 재고유무 CHECK_RETURN = #{CHECKRETURN}, -- 반송유무 UPD_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') WHERE USER_NO = ${USER_NO} AND BUSINESS_LOCATION_NUMBER = ${BUSINESSLOCATIONNUM}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as auth_count, MAX(upd_date) as auth_max_date FROM CBCI_AUTH_CHECK WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_type = #{shopType} AND auth_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_AUTH_CHECK( user_id, shop_type, shop_id, shop_pw, auth_yn, upd_date ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{shopType}, #{shopId}, #{shopPwd}, 'N', now() )
